messages:
maria: Heads-up — after yesterday's RBAC rule tweak + graphql-parser upgrade we started seeing audit-ingest failures in staging during the canary. 5xxs and missing audit events around 03:12 UTC. Can someone triage?

alex_chang: Which dependency bump exactly? CVE-related or behavior change?

maria: graphql-parser 2.1.4 -> 2.2.0 pushed in the dep-update PR (no CVE listed in the PR, but changelog mentions "parser state change"). Not all audit events are arriving at the ELK sink.

jen_liu: saw the spike in errors on canary. Error log from audit-ingest pod: ```ERROR AuditIngest: failed to unmarshal event: unexpected token at position 12
stack: /opt/service/vendor/graphql/parser.go:142```

sre-aaron: Canary metrics: increased tail latency ~180ms on audit writes, CPU up ~15% on node pool-a, and ~0.8% request error rate increase. No pod restarts.

maria: @jen_liu can you run the quick smoke (k8s) and the KMS sign check? We need to confirm it's parsing, not KMS.

jen_liu: Running now: `kubectl logs -n staging deploy/audit-ingest-canary --since=10m | grep unmarshal`
jen_liu: KMS check: `curl -sS https://kms.staging.redwood:8443/healthz` -> OK. Signing latency ~10ms.

sec-bot: CVE scan result: no known CVE for graphql-parser 2.2.0. Advisory: behavioral changes in "sparse-field parsing" may alter event schemas. See: https://vendor.example/changelog/2.2.0

alex_chang: If it's a schema change, older callers may emit fields that new parser rejects. Suggest: 1) set canary to 1% traffic, 2) enable tolerant-parser mode env var, 3) replay failing payloads through a local parser.

jen_liu: Tolerant mode exists: `AUDIT_PARSER_TOLERANT=true` — toggled on canary image, redeploying to one replica. Running replay of first failing payload: ```echo '{...corrupt event...}' | ./parser-local --tolerant=true``` -> parser accepted it (no error).

sre-aaron: After toggling tolerant mode latency back to baseline, error rate dropped. Recommendation: keep tolerant mode and schedule a compatibility patch with vendor. Also create an alert for unmarshal errors >5/min.

maria: Agreed. Patch priority: P2 for immediate workaround (tolerant mode) + P1 for full vendor patch if this can cause missing audit events for production. Need compliance sign-off since audit logs affected.

ops-bot: Canary rollout action: traffic=1%, replicas=1, AUDIT_PARSER_TOLERANT=true applied at 1719810000.

jen_liu: Follow-up steps I ran: smoke tests (write/read audit), KMS sign check, replay of 10 failing events, cpu/latency baseline comparisons. Attached small log excerpt: ```[03:12:21] unmarshal error -> dropped event id=b2f3
[03:12:22] write success -> id=b2f3 (after tolerant mode)```

maria: Filing compliance ticket with evidence and timeline. Will schedule vendor escalation. Thanks all — leave monitoring in place for 24h and we'll re-evaluate before promoting to prod. :thumbsup:

alex_chang: I'll open an RFC for long-term: add parser compatibility test to our regression suite and add a canary gating rule for audit ingestion errors.

sec-bot: Note: recorded as incident draft: INCIDENT-2026-042 (audit-ingest parser incompatibility).
